Name: Nyapu-Style Wellwick Portraits
Author: Louplex
Description:
[size=4]Portraits for NPC [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6462]Wellwick[/url] by undertheR in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu[/url] Art Style (๑>◡<๑)

[/size][b]Daily Portrait's only.
[/b]
[size=4]There are three options to install Portraits. Decide for one :)[/size]

[size=3]1. Standalone[/size]
[size=3]﻿Download this mod via Mod Manager or manually.[/size]
[size=3]If manually, drop in 'Mods' Folder using SMAPI.[/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] needed.[/size][u]

[/u][size=3]2. Via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]
Just started using Portraiture? Create a new folder inside /Portraiture/Portraits and name it however you want.[/size]
[size=3]→  /Portraiture/Portraits/MyNewFolder [/size]
[size=3]Drop Wellwick.png from this mod's folder into that Folder. [/size]

[size=3]Using Portraiture for other Portrait mods alredy? Drop Wellwick.png from this mod into existing folder of your choice. →  /Portraiture/Portraits/FolderIWantToUse[/size]
[size=3]Remove this mod folder since the .png only needs to be in the Portraiture Folder.[/size]

[size=3]3. Directly into 'Prophet Wellwick'-Mod folder.[/size]
Copy the original File somewhere to your drive to backup.
[size=3]Drop Wellwick.png from this mod's folder into Wellwick/portraits to overwrite the mod's file. 
Remove this mod folder, since the .png only needs to be in the Mod's Folder.[/size]
